```{python}
#| include: false

# ── Shared model (same constants as context_explainer.py) ───────
import holoviews as hv
import numpy as np
from bokeh.core.properties import value
from bokeh.models import NumeralTickFormatter

hv.extension("bokeh")

DISPLAY = "Verdana, sans-serif"
BODY    = "Verdana, sans-serif"
INK, MUTED, HAIRLINE = "#1a1a1a", "#6b7280", "#d1d5db"
ACCENT, ACCENT_SOFT  = "#2563eb", "#dbeafe"
DANGER, DANGER_SOFT  = "#dc2626", "#fee2e2"

SYS, TURN, MAX_TURNS = 3000, 650, 60

def total_read(n):
    return n * SYS + TURN * (n * (n + 1)) // 2

def thread_len(n):
    return n * TURN

def fmt(n):
    return f"{round(n):,}"

def font_hook(plot, element):
    fig = plot.state
    if fig.title is not None:
        fig.title.text_font = DISPLAY
        fig.title.text_font_style = "bold"
        fig.title.text_font_size = "15pt"
        fig.title.text_color = INK
    for axis in fig.axis:
        axis.axis_label_text_font = BODY
        axis.axis_label_text_font_style = "normal"
        axis.axis_label_text_color = MUTED
        axis.major_label_text_font = BODY
        axis.major_label_text_color = MUTED
        axis.axis_line_color = HAIRLINE
        axis.major_tick_line_color = HAIRLINE
        axis.minor_tick_line_color = None
    fig.outline_line_color = None
    for r in fig.renderers:
        glyph = getattr(r, "glyph", None)
        if glyph is not None and hasattr(glyph, "text_font"):
            glyph.text_font = value(BODY)

BASE = dict(toolbar=None, show_grid=False, show_legend=False,
            hooks=[font_hook], fontscale=1.05)
```


## {.center}

[The big picture]{.section-label}

### What Really Happens When You Chat with AI

A 40-message conversation feels like 40 short exchanges.
Behind the scenes, it's **much** more work than that.

:::{style="display:flex;gap:40px;justify-content:center;margin:24px 0"}

:::{style="text-align:center"}
[40]{style="font-size:48px;font-weight:700"}

[messages you sent]{style="font-size:14px;color:#6b7280"}
:::

:::{style="text-align:center"}
[653,000]{style="font-size:48px;font-weight:700;color:#2563eb"}

[words the AI processed]{style="font-size:14px;color:#6b7280"}
:::

:::{style="text-align:center"}
[25x]{style="font-size:48px;font-weight:700;color:#dc2626"}

[more than you'd expect]{style="font-size:14px;color:#6b7280"}
:::

:::

. . .

The AI has no memory between messages.
Every time you hit send, it *re-reads the entire conversation from the beginning*.


## {.center}

[How it works]{.section-label}

### Every Message Starts from Scratch

There's no memory. Each time you press send, the AI receives
**the entire conversation again**.

```{python}
import pandas as pd

rounds = [1, 2, 3, 4]
payload = [SYS + TURN * i for i in rounds]
setup = [SYS] * 4
prior = [TURN * i - TURN for i in rounds]
current = [TURN] * 4

bars_current = hv.Bars(
    [(f"Round {r}", v) for r, v in zip(rounds, current)], "Round", "words"
).opts(color=ACCENT, alpha=0.9)
bars_prior = hv.Bars(
    [(f"Round {r}", v) for r, v in zip(rounds, prior)], "Round", "words"
).opts(color=ACCENT, alpha=0.35)
bars_setup = hv.Bars(
    [(f"Round {r}", v) for r, v in zip(rounds, setup)], "Round", "words"
).opts(color=MUTED, alpha=0.3)

stacked = hv.Overlay([bars_setup, bars_prior, bars_current])

labels = hv.Labels(
    [(f"Round {r}", p + 200, f"{p:,}") for r, p in zip(rounds, payload)]
).opts(color=ACCENT, text_font_size="9pt")

(stacked * labels).opts(
    width=600, height=300, **BASE,
    ylabel="words received by AI",
    title="Each round re-sends everything before it",
    yformatter=NumeralTickFormatter(format="0a"),
    ylim=(0, max(payload) * 1.15),
)
```

:::{style="text-align:center;color:#1e40af;font-size:0.85em;margin-top:8px"}
You typed **2,600** words. The AI processed **18,500** — **7x** what you wrote.
:::

::: {.notes}
The right column grows because every round re-sends all prior rounds
plus the setup instructions. That's the whole mechanism.
:::


## {.center}

[The cost]{.section-label}

### The Longer You Go, the Worse It Gets

Each new message re-reads *all* the previous ones.
The total work **accelerates**.

```{python}
n = 40
x = np.arange(0, n + 1)
read = np.array([total_read(i) for i in x])
typed = np.array([thread_len(i) for i in x])

gap = hv.Area((x, typed, read), vdims=["y", "y2"]).opts(
    color=ACCENT, alpha=0.12, line_alpha=0)
c_read = hv.Curve((x, read)).opts(color=ACCENT, line_width=3)
c_typed = hv.Curve((x, typed)).opts(
    color=MUTED, line_width=2, line_dash="dashed")
lbl_read = hv.Text(n, total_read(n), " AI's workload",
                   halign="left", valign="bottom").opts(
                       color=ACCENT, text_font_size="10pt")
lbl_typed = hv.Text(n, total_read(MAX_TURNS) * 0.045,
                    " your messages",
                    halign="left", valign="bottom").opts(
                        color=MUTED, text_font_size="10pt")

(gap * c_typed * c_read * lbl_read * lbl_typed).opts(
    width=700, height=340, **BASE,
    xlim=(0, MAX_TURNS * 1.1), ylim=(0, total_read(MAX_TURNS) * 1.05),
    yformatter=NumeralTickFormatter(format="0.0a"),
    xlabel="messages", ylabel="words",
    title="The longer you go, the worse it gets")
```

::: {.notes}
Pause here — this is the load-bearing idea. The curve is quadratic,
not linear. Every message costs more than the one before it.
:::


## {.center}

[The problem]{.section-label}

### Mistakes Never Go Away

When the AI guesses wrong, that wrong answer **stays forever**.
Correcting it doesn't remove it.

:::{style="display:flex;gap:32px;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start"}

:::{style="flex:1;max-width:320px;font-size:0.65em"}

| # | Message |
|:---:|:---|
| 1 | 🧑 set up the training pipeline |
| 2 | 🤖 sure, here is a pipeline config |
| 3 | 🧑 it needs to checkpoint every epoch |
| 4 | [🤖 I'll assume you have a GPU]{style="color:#dc2626;font-weight:600"} |
| 5 | 🧑 no, this runs on CPU only |
| 6 | 🤖 understood, switching to CPU |
| 7 | 🧑 the setup still references GPU software |
| … | *corrections continue…* |

:::

:::{style="flex:1;max-width:300px;background:#fafafa;border-radius:10px;padding:16px;font-size:0.75em"}

**The wrong answer**

[Message 4: *"I'll assume you have a GPU"*]{style="background:#fee2e2;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 8px;display:inline-block"}

Every new message re-reads the mistake alongside your corrections, making the AI **more likely to get confused again**.

:::

:::

::: {.notes}
The mistake in message 4 is re-read on every subsequent turn.
By message 12, the AI has re-read it 8 times — alongside 8 corrections
that are trying to undo it.
:::


## {.center}

[The fix]{.section-label}

### Go Back and Edit, Don't Keep Talking

Most chat apps have a pencil icon next to your messages.
**Go back to the message that caused the problem** and rewrite it.

:::{style="display:flex;gap:24px;justify-content:center;font-size:0.7em"}

:::{style="flex:1;max-width:300px"}
[A — Keep correcting]{style="font-weight:700;color:#dc2626;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:0.8em;letter-spacing:0.06em"}

12 messages

**AI workload: [539,500]{style="color:#dc2626"}** words

The wrong answer stays forever.
:::

:::{style="flex:1;max-width:300px"}
[B — Edit the original]{style="font-weight:700;color:#2563eb;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:0.8em;letter-spacing:0.06em"}

4 messages

**AI workload: [26,650]{style="color:#2563eb"}** words ✏️

The wrong answer is gone.
:::

:::

. . .

:::{style="text-align:center;color:#1e40af;margin-top:20px"}
**95% less work for the AI** — and the mistake is erased, not buried.
:::

::: {.notes}
Most chat apps have a pencil icon next to your messages. Use it.
:::


## {.center}

[Takeaways]{.section-label}

### Three Things to Remember

You don't need to understand the technology. Just keep these in mind.

. . .

**1. Long chats get worse, not just longer.**
The AI re-reads everything every time you send a message.

. . .

**2. When it goes wrong, go back — don't pile on.**
Find the message that caused it and use the pencil icon to rewrite.

. . .

**3. Fresh starts are free — use them.**
Start a new chat when the topic changes or things feel off.
